soil_facts.text: Use compost-enriched, moisture-retentive but well-drained soil. Avoid cold, waterlogged ground and heavy nitrogen feeding.

sowing_notes.text: Hardy round-seeded peas can overwinter from protected November sowings in mild areas. Later sowings face more heat, mildew and moths.

final_tips.text: Start early crops under cover and sow short rows in succession for manageable pickings.
Pick frequently: pods left to mature can slow further cropping.
